findings.evidenceJa: また妙な勘違いをしている
findings.governingReading: 勘違い is another mistaken interpretation of Shirou’s response, not an elaborate rationalization.

findings.highlight: Then you can count on me.
findings.evidenceJa: それなら遠坂はずっと味方
findings.governingReading: 遠坂はずっと味方 makes Rin his continuing ally; her reply limits it to a short time.
findings.explanation: Shirou’s conclusion that Rin will always be an ally becomes an assurance that she can count on him.

findings.governingReading: とりとめのない describes the conversation’s unfocused form while it covers how he learned magecraft.
findings.explanation: Rambling conversation is characterized as unimportant material.

findings.highlight: She gets mad for an entirely different reason.
findings.evidenceJa: 我がコトのように怒り出す
findings.governingReading: 我がコトのように marks personally invested anger about his reckless disclosure.
findings.explanation: Rin reacting as though it were her own affair becomes anger for a different reason.

findings.evidenceJa: 今すっごく後悔してる
findings.governingReading: 今すっごく後悔してる explicitly admits regret after Rin’s ominous response.
findings.explanation: Shirou’s present regret about revealing weaknesses becomes simply getting the point.

findings.highlight: I had to teach you a lesson!
findings.evidenceJa: つい灸を据えるっていうか、つっつきたくなった
findings.governingReading: つい and つっつきたくなった present an impulsive desire to poke/chastise him, with hesitant wording.
findings.explanation: Rin’s impulse to prod him becomes having to teach him a lesson.
